%doc: Source-of-truth manifest for the `comm_link` Bucket table: one row per Comm-Link page, written by Module:CommLink from the {{Infobox commlink}} arguments. Comm-Link pages hold no Entity row, so {{Comm-Link list}} roots its query on this bucket (DataGrid `primary`). Property names carry the `Comm-Link ` prefix because Module:BucketQuery resolves every registered manifest from one flat namespace. type/bucket/field/index are the Bucket keys; desc is documentation only.

Comm-Link title.desc: The Comm-Link's title as the infobox shows it, from `title`.

Comm-Link series.desc: The series, from `series`. The previous/next bar that {{Infobox commlink}} renders reads every row of the page's series.

Comm-Link type.desc: The Comm-Link type (Spectrum Dispatch, Transmission, ...), from `type`.

Comm-Link published.desc: Publication date as ISO YYYY-MM-DD: the first date in `publicationdate`, zero-padded; empty when it holds none. TEXT because ISO dates sort chronologically as strings.

Comm-Link ID.desc: The RSI Comm-Link number from `url`; orders Comm-Links published on the same day.
